documents.content: On June 1, 2026, the user received physiotherapy at Clinic A. The treatment provided limited improvement.
On July 10, 2026, the user received shockwave therapy. The reported outcome was no significant improvement.
On August 5, 2026, the user received a corticosteroid injection for hip pain. The treatment reduced pain temporarily.
Between March and April 2026, the user completed six sessions of manual therapy. The treatment did not produce meaningful long-term improvement.
In May 2026, the user tried stretching and mobility exercises. These exercises provided some short-term relief but symptoms returned afterward.
In February 2026, the user received a local anesthetic injection for hip pain. The injection provided temporary pain reduction.
In January 2026, the user started a strengthening exercise program. The user reported that the exercises sometimes increased discomfort.
The user reported burning pain in the lower back and left hip, which became worse after prolonged standing.
The user reported pain radiating from the lower back into the left thigh and buttock.
The user experiences burning discomfort around the outside of the left hip, particularly after prolonged activity.
The user reported anterior hip pain together with discomfort around the lateral hip.
The user reported that sitting for long periods can aggravate symptoms in the lower back and hip.
The user described pain extending from the lower back toward the left buttock and upper leg.
During a medical visit in September 2026, the physician reviewed the user's previous treatments and ongoing symptoms.
During a medical appointment in May 2026, the physician reviewed the user's persistent hip and lower-back symptoms.
At a follow-up appointment in July 2026, the user discussed the lack of improvement after previous conservative treatments.
In January 2026, the user began a new strengthening program for persistent hip and lower-back symptoms.
In June 2026, the user continued experiencing persistent hip pain despite previous physiotherapy.
In August 2026, the user reported temporary relief after receiving an injection for hip pain.
By September 2026, the user continued to report ongoing symptoms despite trying multiple treatments.
